desc: Ideation: select Kruskal reconstruction tree + LCA (Euler tour RMQ) as the approach for widest-path queries.

Implement the complete Python solution using a Kruskal reconstruction tree: sort cells by height descending, DSU activation creating internal nodes, iterative Euler tour, segment-tree RMQ for LCA, and answer max(abs(y-z), y+z-2*M).
Check edge cases (N=1, same building, equal heights, all heights 1) and tune memory/time for 250k cells and 2e5 queries; public samples passed.
